notes.title: QoL/guidance update
notes.content: [p][b][u]Gameplay changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Areas of interest on the map now light up or spark, to provide more guidance and direction for players[/p][p]-If an area is in accessible, the right-click cursor turns red instead of the usual green[/p][p]-ActionBar items removal changed to middle-click to prevent accidental removal of an action/spell while walking[/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]Bugs:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Game no longer crashes when accessing inventory by clicking on bag when party is selected[/p][p]-Characters no longer switch as main character when right-click-moving and then hovering over another party member or over the party-hp-menu on the left side[/p]

notes.title: Yellow Rune Quest
notes.content: [p][b][u]Gameplay[/u][/b][/p][p]-New Areas include "Tomb of the Nemi'Saan" and "Nemi'Saan Palace" for higher level players [/p][p]-Yellow Rune Quest complete[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Bugs[/u][/b][/p][p]-Numerous minor bugs fixed, including pathing, dialogue, etc.[/p]

notes.title: Graphics overhaul
notes.content: [p][u][b]Areas of graphical change:[/b][/u][/p][p]-Adventurer's Haven[/p][p]-Kettorek Forest[/p][p]-Eastern Wilds[/p][p]-Southern Hills[/p][p]-Western Desert[/p][p]-Kingdom of Eldnor[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Minor changes
notes.content: [p][b][u]QoL changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Reduced length of introduction cutscene (can always be skipped)[/p][p]-Character Creation screen now shows race/class when hovered over each icon[/p][p]-Cleaned up minor areas on inventory screen and player storage[/p][p]-Can press “Esc” anytime to close a menu[/p][p]-Game in “Story Mode” starts with a mini-battle[/p]

notes.title: Standalone Colosseum Battles
notes.content: [p][b][u]New Gameplay mode[/u][/b][/p][p]-Colosseum mode now available.  This is a non-story mode that can be played separately with your characters.  All experience/items/gold received here can be transferred over to the main story line.[/p][p]-This is a combat-only mode that can have upto 16 of your characters pitted against NPCs of all strengths.[/p][p]-There are no negative faction hits on any opponent fought in Colosseum mode.[/p]

notes.title: New Tutorial Area
notes.content: [p][b][u]QoL changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-New tutorial area "Adventurer's Haven", with 2 NPCs that can join you as well as an arena that spawns easy monsters for XP/Gold.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Gameplay changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Old zone "Adventurer's Haven" renamed to "Kettorek Forest[/p][p]-Colliseum moved to north of Eldnor[/p][p]-Improved payout at colliseum[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Bugs:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Fixed minor bugs when selecting party and then pressing ‘C’ would not allow to select items unless multiple clicks occurred first[/p]

notes.title: White Rune Quest Complete
notes.content: [p][b][u]QoL changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Fixed some minor graphical issues with widescreen fullscreen mode[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Gameplay changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-White Rune Quest Completion gives each class a bonus skill as well as can change alignment depending on actions of good/evil[/p][p]                -Warrior – Shockwave (line AoE)[/p][p]                -Rogue – Set Trap (random trap for opponents)[/p][p]                -Cleric – Healing Rain (heals party)[/p][p]                -Mage – Lightning Bolt (lightning + stun)[/p][p]                -Noble – Mesmerize (crowd control AoE)[/p][p]                -Barbarian – Rapidheal (triggered passive when physically hit)[/p][p]                -Adventurer – Song of Battle (party buff)[/p][p]-Steam Achievement for White Rune Quest Completion[/p][p]-Whirlwind attack no longer hits party members within range of the attack[/p][p]-Cannot attack/cast spells if there is a wall/door between target and actor[/p]

notes.title: Updates/Improvements
notes.content: [p]Thank you to those who have provided feedback and have given this game a chance.  I will continue to work on its development in hopes to fully release by sometime December 2025.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]QoL changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Notifications if ITEM or GOLD is successfully stolen (or not) from an NPC[/p][p]-Notifications if a trap is disarmed or not[/p][p]-Improved feedback during battle moreso (xp/gold, animation delays)[/p][p]-New sprites for main characters to help keep artwork more consistent[/p][p]-Improved look of Character Creation Screen to help improve consistency[/p][p][b][u]Gameplay changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-White Rune Quest is 75% complete (still work in progress)[/p][p]-NPCs will talk more often depending on the area or event (still work in progress)[/p][p]-Added more items, some with unique effects (insta-kill, and respawn at site of death)[/p][p]-Balanced NPCs, and added new NPCs[/p][p]-Added more low-level NPCs near the starting zone[/p][p]-improved recovery skill[/p][p]-Stunned NPCs (if they are above 1/2 full action bar) will have their action bar reduced to ½ full and remain there for duration of the stun[/p][p][b][u]Spell changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-New spells/effects, including healing rain, and fatal strike[/p][p]-Mage loses “Flame Jet”, but gains “Mageshield”[/p][p]-“Flame Jet” is now faith-based and cleric starts out with the spell[/p][p]-Balanced many spells[/p][p]-Party members who can cast AoE won’t do so as it can harm party members[/p][p]-NPCs won’t repeatedly cast buff/debuff spells if the same one already takes effect[/p][p]-Fixed fireball to engulf (DoT) more npcs in flames[/p][p]-Changed artwork of some spells[/p][p]-Pets will attack your target as opposed to simply defending you if you are attacked first[/p][p][b][u]Bugs:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Fixed some bugs with auto-on/auto-off[/p][p]-Fixed bug that caused some spell animations staying on the screen permanently[/p]

notes.title: Optimization and more QoL
notes.content:
[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-Game optimized so it no longer drops FPS or hog up CPU when controlling a large party.
-Field of vision around character is improved so that huge trees/objects don’t block the player character
-Adding characters to the party on Menu Screen made easier -- Can now hold down/drag left-mouse button to select all characters into party in Main Menu (useful if you have many characters).  
-NPCs that can’t be seen by the player character (i.e. hidden, distant) are drawn more transparently
-Party members that can level up show more clearly on the side party-tab with a Star icon
-Party members who are lower HP are now more clearly shown on the side party-tab 
-Death animations are more clear
-Gold/XP received from final hit notifications are more clear

notes.title: Improved Turn-Based Modes
notes.content:
[p][b][u]QoL changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]
-Game has three separate modes of combat:[/p][list][*][p](Default) ARPG style.[/p][p]Control 1 player in continuous mode, with (upto-15) party members supporting you automatically based upon your party settings.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Turn-Based + Party AI.[/p][p]This mode is just like ARPG style but the game pauses when it's your character's turn. Party members will automatically support based upon your settings.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Classic Turn-Based (Turn-Based + Party Manual).[/p][p]Control every player when it is their turn to move. It will automatically switch to the party member whose turn it is.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]-If a player is stunned and cannot move/act it is now shown more clearly.[/p][p]-Made party attack notifications clearer when left-clicking on an NPC.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Gameplay changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-NPCs that join the party move faster than when they are not in the party[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ver 0.9.3.33, date 7/18/2025
notes.content: [p][b][u]Gameplay changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-NPCs can now join your party on quests throughout zones, assuming they decide to join you.  They can join you in combat and share exp/gold if they get the final hit, but no faction loss/gain to party members. If they die, they will respawn later in the game after some time, depending on the NPC[/p][p]-New Quest available[/p][p]-New Zone, “Southern Hills” available but still barren[/p][p][b][u]Spell changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Flame Jet, Fireball, and some fire-based weapons all have a chance to engulf the target in flames (DoT)[/p][p] [/p][p][b][u]Bugs:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Fixed bug when de-selecting party members wouldn’t hide the “Resume Saved Area” button, resulting in a crash if clicked upon[/p]

notes.title: ver 0.9.3.23, date 7/15/2025, small patch
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Shops in Eldnor are complete with new items

notes.title: ver 0.9.3.22, date 7/13/2025
notes.content: [p][b][u]QoL changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Turn-based combat mode adds more appropriate pauses/delays during hectic combat, to improve feedback to player[/p][p]-Additional notifications during battle to improve feedback to player[/p][p]-Saved party settings and default settings now available upon start[/p][p][b][u]Gameplay changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Added Pool/Split party gold option on party menu[/p][p]-Player Horses are kept (if alive) when moving zone to zone, even upon exiting the game[/p][p]-Fixed “No Attack/disengage” party option[/p]

notes.title: More gameplay improvements and updates
notes.content: [p]Game can be played using a party of 1 single player character or upto 16.  The sweet spot maybe 3-4 party members, but you do you.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]QoL changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Smoothed out party control and movements with mouse[/p][p]-Made Neutral opponents able to be attacked without having to turn off friendly-fire or having to shift-left-click[/p][p]-Added more attack animations to make it clear who is attacking who[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Gameplay changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Improved melee range, so the player doesn’t feel they have to be super close to an NPC in order to attack[/p][p]-Can Train to Level 12[/p][p]-Added more items, some with special attacks (like DoT, slow, drain)[/p][p]-Eldnor spell shop is completed[/p][p]-Balancing of characters done so that big dumb ogre barbarians don’t have over 100 MP at level 12[/p]

notes.title: more QoL
notes.content:
[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-Made objects transparent (i.e. trees) when mouse is hovering over, to prevent blocking the player's view of the characters
-ongoing improvement with party mouse control
-fixed bug where player character would get stuck in some areas if right-clicking for movement

notes.title: More improvements with mouse/party-movements
notes.content: [p][b][u]QoL changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-improved mouse/party interface[/p][p]-Top right shows continuous vs turn-based icon, can be toggled with side menu or 'F6'[/p][p]-Removed idle-rpg mode.[/p][p]-Party members can be selected individually or as a whole group, and can move together when right-clicking[/p][p]-More party commands (i.e. default follow leader, hold position, attack my target, defend, etc.)[/p]

notes.title: Party movement with mouse
notes.content: [p][u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u][/p][p]-Thanks to player feedback, an alternative way to selec party characters and movement can be accessed using the mouse/click-drag.  Still a work in progress.[/p][p]-Party commands made more accessible[/p][p][u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u][/p][p]-Ongoing work with Eldnor shops, still unfinished, but in progress[/p][p]-Eldnor map now available[/p]

notes.title: Several UI and gameplay QoL updates
notes.content:
[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-Improved visualization during turn-based combat notification
-Improved UI viewing with targeting, such that only the target’s hp bar is solid, and non-targets hp-bar are transparent.  This will hopefully reduce clutter.
-Improved UI feedback such that It is made clearer if a move can’t be done due to lack of mana, stamina, or out of range
-Can cycle party members as target with ‘Y’
-Party members will auto-eat food available when hungry
-Made NPCs less fidgety so they don’t move as often and can be easier to click on

[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]
-Fixed a bug that would crash the game when entering some shops.
-Fixed bugs that would crash the game if a target died while using ‘T’

notes.title: minor patch, 6/28/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Increased ‘Recover’ stamina repletion to a minimum of ‘20’ to help make combat classes more viable early on
-Disarm Trap reduced to 0 MP required
-Added new NPCs to fight

[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-‘Recover’ doesn’t make sound effect anymore (as NPCs in your party will use this constantly when not in combat and not 100%)

[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]
-Fixed a bug that would crash the game when entering some shops.

notes.title: ver 0.9.2.02, date 6/27/2025
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has given feedback to my Early Access title!  This is a work in progress with a hope to complete by December 2025.

[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]
-Fixed crashes that occur when player creation occurs, thanks to Streamer feedback

[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Diagonal movement now exists thanks to player review feedback

[u][b]Other:[/b][/u]
-Bar toggle and Quit more clearly show they need to be dbl-clicked
-Sped-up cutscene intro (can always be skipped)
-Made minor changes to side-menu layout
-Made it clearly show fullscreen toggle (F3) on intro
-Cleaned up tutorial further, thanks to streamer feedback

notes.title: ver 0.9.2, date 6/22/2025
notes.content: [p][b][u]QoL changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Can now start the game at the *Last Area* that the player was at, to save from having to walk from the beginning area every time.[/p][p]-All added players will default to joining the party from the start, to prevent having to click on each one to join individually from the gamestart[/p][p]-Added ‘Defend’ and ‘Ranged’ icons to party to improve clarity of party member’s actions[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Gameplay changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Added New Zone – ‘Library’ (unfinished)[/p][p]-Added ‘Knight’s Armory’ in Eldnor, with many new items (other stores/shops/buildings still a work in progress)[/p][p]-Added more special items throughout existing zones[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ver 0.9.1.2, Date 6/19/2025
notes.content: [p][b][u]QoL changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-Can cycle nearby NPCs as targets with ‘T’[/p][p]-Group attacking a target won’t take effect if the target is in the party[/p][p]-Group attacking is now notified on the message log to be clear[/p][p]-Made status bars clearer with a color outline if 100%[/p][p]-Left-clicking on party member name on the party-panel targets that party-member[/p][p]-Right-click on party member name on the party-panel switches to control that party-member[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]Gameplay changes:[/u][/b][/p][p]-All NPCs and PCs can ride horses, and can be also be knocked off horse if the horse is killed or if rider attacks its own horse.[/p]

notes.title: ver 0.9.1.11, date 6/4/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Minor changes to combat and some NPCs

notes.title: ver 0.9.1.1, date 6/3/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Party members AI improved to heal each other, disarm traps, recover when there’s downtime
-Improved party member erratic pathing, including kiting AI
-Your Party members will no longer attack each other (unless you specifically micro this)

notes.title: Landonia update, ver 0.9.1.0, date 6/1/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Members in the same party will share experience and gold from NPC kills
-Rogues in the party will use “Disarm Trap” automatically
-Zone Eastern Wilds has more content
-Zone Kingdom of Eldnor able to be explored, but has limited content (work in progress)
-Tents on area maps can restore hp/mp, at the cost of food.  Can’t be used if there are opponents nearby.
-Kills and Deaths are counted, and may soon be a Steam Achievement
-If a character dies more than 50 times in a playthrough it will be permadeath at that point
-More weapon balancing regarding stamina requirement per weapon/attack mode

[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-Party Members show up as members on UI
-Transition to Areas with new area names show more clearly

notes.title: ver 0.9.0.6, date 5/25/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-Damage numbers appropriately fade out, to avoid screen clutter. 
-Ranged weapons and spells now show animation during battle

notes.title: ver 0.9.0.5, date 5/22/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Horseback riding is a Steam Achievement
-Filled out Eastern Wilds more so, though still relatively empty
-Included more NPC pathing and patrolling
-Improved randomness of item drops
-Improved AI combat to include more variance in enemy commands at a higher frequency

[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-Improved UI to handle larger player/NPC names and increase size of info and dialogue bars

[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]
-If a horse dies while being ridden on, the player’s move states are appropriately displayed

notes.title: ver 0.9.0.5, date 5/20/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Horseback riding is now available
-Eastern Wilds Zone can be explored, though unfinished

notes.title: ver 0.9.0.4, date 5/17/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Colosseum area now has NPCs and a concession stand to make it more interactive

[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-‘Remove Bars’ on Menu bar requires double-clicking to avoid accidental removal

[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]
-Grumdorf's Gemstore no longer crashes game

notes.title: Colosseum Open
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/u]
-New Zone north of starting zone called "Battle Pits", which is a colosseum-type zone where one can wager on which NPC survives!  Can win or lose gold depending on your luck!

notes.title: ver 0.9.0.2, date 5/12/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Improved aggro calculations of NPCs

[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-Made Quit/Save button double/triple-click before saving/quitting to prevent accidental quitting.

notes.title: ver 0.9.0.0, date 5/11/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-Idle-mode is now an option on the Side Menu (F6), and doesn’t require cycling through all characters prior
-Improved areas of user interface

notes.title: ver 0.8.9.9.6, date 5/9/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Included “kite” AI mode for NPCs or party members

[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-Holding Left-click or holding “Esc” speeds up dialogue as an option to skip lengthy conversations
-When a player NPC is selected, the party icon bar does not disappear with movement.  This should help with controlling party members more easily.

[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]
-Fixed bug that won’t save EXP when using teleporter
-Self-targeting with "tab" no longer causes faction display issues when hovering over NPCs afterwards

notes.title: ver 0.8.9.9.5, date 5/5/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Added spell ‘Mark Zone’ to teleport to saved zone
-Added ‘Teleport Altar” in main zone for ‘Mark Zone’.  Requires a ‘crystallized slime’ per use.
-Envenom applies to bow weapons as well, so you can poison targets from range
-Balanced MoveSpeed
-Reduced Blind duration
-Reduced ‘King Kur’ MoveSpeed
-Balanced Combat requirements for higher-level attacks
-New Area, ‘Eastern Wilds’ in progress of being made

[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-Improved graphical feedback (holy weapons cause explosion animation on unholy NPCs, poisoned creatures will blink green periodically while poisoned)

[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]
-Fixed bug with some NPCs (green slime, beetle, elk, horse, rabbit) not showing on chat dialogue correctly or attacking correctly
-Fixed bugs with Sacrifical Altar
-Fixed more chatgoblin bugs

notes.title: ver 0.8.9.9.4+, date 5/3/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-Improved graphics in subtle areas

[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]
-Fixed bug where Stamina bar doesn’t appropriately reflect current stamina
-Fixed bug where some spells don't show in 2.5d mode

notes.title: ver 0.8.9.94, date 5/2/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Battle music now accounts for distance to NPC, whereas prior it accounted for “vision” of that NPC.  This provides less abrupt interruptions/changes to battle music.
-Wand damage no longer includes a player’s Strength as part of the calculation.

[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]
-Fixed bug where the dreaded “chatgoblin” will show up instead of the appropriate NPC talking
-Fixed moonwalking through walls bug when going up/downstairs or teleporting
-Fixed factions of guardsmen in Elsalt Abbey

notes.title: ver 0.8.9.93, date 5/1/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Added “Wand” as a new ranged weapon-class that can be used in 1-hand, as opposed to bows. These cannot be Evaded/Dodged, and cannot Backstab or Critical.  They drain mana however and cannot be used with Whirlwind or Envenom skills.  They can be used with shields, and be dual-wielded with another weapon if desired.
-Mages start with “Apprentice Wand” which has lightning damage
-Elsalt Abbey has more content, but not yet complete.

[u][b]Spell changes:[/b][/u]
-“Summon Minor Servant” minions attack with a “wand”-type attack with “ice” damage, and no longer have “Magic Missile” and “Healing” skills

[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-Improved graphics of certain attack effects and attack sounds
-Steal Item command when used on NPC will provide appropriate graphic and sound when items or gold are successfully stolen

notes.title: ver 0.8.9.92, date 4/28/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-Party system improved such that the party remains the same throughout zones, and your members will follow you throughout zones
-Improved the fit/look of name/hpbar when hovering over NPCs

[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Party members have an “Attack your Target” option that can be toggled.  The default is for party members to attack your target.
-Summoned pets will automatically “Attack your Target”
-Elsyth Abbey is being built, but not yet completed.

notes.title: version 0.8.9.9.1, date 4/24/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]
-fixed bug that buying/selling items result in losing the “Exit” button on shop, requiring someone to push ‘C’
-fixed bugs that caused game to crash when shift-click buying/selling or inventory management with community chest

[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-NPCs at the beginning of a new area all start with full HP/MP/Stamina
-Adventurers gain ‘Proficiency’ active skill
-Adventurers lose ‘Backstab’ passive skill (they can still do surprise attacks like all characters however)

[u][b]Spell changes:[/b][/u]
-New skill, ‘Proficiency’, gives Warriors and Adventurers are temporary boost to ‘Combat’ ability, allowing them improved combat abilities across the board (i.e. accuracy, critical, #of attacks), as well as potential access to more complex attacks (depending on weapon complexity level)
-‘Backstab’ skill changed to Rogue-only.
-‘Backstab’ skill changed to requiring a 1-handed melee piercing weapon equipped to gain the x4 damage instead of the normal ‘surprise’ attack giving x3 damage.

notes.title: Graphics 2.5D Setting
notes.content:
[u][b]QoL Updates[/b][/u]
Users can toggle between 2D and 2.5D by pressing 'B' during the game or by selecting the appropriate setting on the right-hand panel.

notes.title: Landonia version 0.8.9.8, date 4/18/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]QoL changes:[/b][/u]
-PgUp and PgDown cycles through all characters correctly as well as switches to “idle-rpg” mode when no character is selected
-When moving to a new zone, the selected character will now remain persistently selected in the new zone
-Sounds updated for weapons hitting/ missing, “Whirlwind”, purchasing/selling, inventory, and equipping/unequipping items
-Stamina appropriately shows in stats screen
-Stats screen improved visually
-Area descriptions now included under hotkey “F”

[u][b]Bugs:[/b][/u]
-F2 hotkey for settings doesn’t show random pop-ups
-Traps no longer cause damage even when game is paused
-Fixed sprite issues with human female cleric
-Fixed non-responsive side-buttons when Help, Pause, IconHelp, Bar Show, were clicked

[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Item data now flagged as “Magical”, “Holy”, “Cursed”, and “Unique”
-An NPC can only possess one type of unique item at a time.
-Improved proc rate of weapons with extra damage (i.e. pure/fire/ice/lightning) and weapons with this can now be used with “Whirlwind” skill
-Fixed ‘Shield Bash’ to proc appropriately as well as added sound-effect 
-Some faith-based spells will change depending on if a character is Unholy or not
-Guardsmen have gained the “Dash” ability, and lose the “Heal” ability.
-Drinking beer provides ‘beer goggles’ and cures blindness, but reduces Stamina
-Spiritual Force spell affects Unholy characters’  HP/MP/Stamina
-Unholy NPCs wearing Holy items will get punished by a Spiritual Force
-Likewise, normal NPCs wearing Cursed Items will have faith, combat, casting, and hunger negatively affected
-Cannot earn EXP beyond level-required EXP
-Imps start with 50% fire resistance
-Balanced racial encumbrance bonuses
-Yellow (stamina) and Green (cure poison) potions implemented into the game

[b][u]Spell changes:[/u][/b]
-New skill “Dash” granted to Warrior and Barbarian characters that provides a brief burst of movement speed without costing AP.  This will help close-in on ranged attackers who may be kiting you.
-New spell “Curse” granted to all “Unholy” characters that decreases a target’s combat, casting, accuracy, and faith stats
-Balanced damage output of direct damage spells

notes.title: Landonia Update
notes.content:
[u][b]Quality of Life Changes:[/b][/u]
-Pressing “C”, “F”, and “V” toggles those appropriate screens ON/OFF.  “Exit”, Esc, and Spacebar also do the same.
-Quick-move items -- Shift Left-click can now be used to “Auto-Equip/UnEquip/Store/Sell” depending on the screen
-Pressing “E” interacts with NPCs or Objects, just like “Right-Click”
-Help instructions available on inventory screens
-Character Create Screen contains more data

[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Exp is capped at max of current level, until trained to the next level
-Toadstool NPCs resist fire reduced from -100% to -20%
-Added more scattered treasure in Adventurer’s Haven

notes.title: ver 0.8.9.2, date 3/9/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Other[/b][/u]
-Credits button added to Main Menu screen

[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-AP/Stamina increased even moreso to improve gameplay at earlier levels
-Improved "Recover" skill to add at least 10 stamina, and 3 Mana.  Both those numbers are dependent on respective skills and levels.
-Improved visuals of stats screen regarding showing weapon/armor stats
-Improved information of “Attack” Skill to show special attacks per “Combat Level”
-Improved chances of NPC aggro if hostiles nearby
-Changed evade and weapon accuracy calculations to make evade more relevant
-Changed “Primitive Spear” to a 1-H Pierce

[u][b]Spell changes:[/b][/u]
-Improved power of “Negotiate” (charm spell)
-Improved range of “Blind” from “Short” to “Far”

notes.title: ver 0.8.9.1, date 3/8/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/u]
-Major revision of combat skills and weapons

The hope is that this change makes the particular choices of weapon (i.e. 1-H + shield, vs 2-H, vs dual wield) as well as the "Combat" skill level, actually make a noticeable difference in gameplay and gameplay style.  This will also make weapons more relevant over time and in comparison to each other.

-Fixed bug where if you died, negative spells on you are reset so that they don't continue to harm you after revival.
-Appropriately adjusted Defense calculations

notes.title: ver 0.8.9.0, date 3/6/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Gameplay changes:[/b][/u]
-Stamina increased significantly to improve gameplay at earlier levels, as combat involved "Recover" after 2-3 actions at low levels.
-Further balancing done regarding AP/init, as characters at level 10 already hit max speeds, essentially breaking the game
-Weapon/Attack special proc rate now exists to prevent it from happening 100% of the time

[u][b]Spell and Ability changes:[/b][/u]
-Fixed “Blind” spell to act appropriately to targets, which can prevent targets from attacking or casting if they cannot see the target
-“Blind” changed to a faith-based spell, no longer casting-based
-“Ensnare” can be resistable depending on character/NPC level
-Quickness now adds +5 init, in addition to movement speed
-“Rage” ability from barbarians now adds +5 init, and lengthened in duration
-New Faith/Cleric spell “Slow Action” reduces init by 5
-Nerfed “Prayer” defenses and duration, it still is strong.
-Buffed “Magic Missiles” damage
-Buffed “Fireball” damage

[u][b]Character changes:[/b][/u]
-Cleric-
	-Gains new spell “Slow Action”
	-Gains new spell “Blind”
	-Loses spell “Holy Force” (for new characters made) – this spell can be found/bought

notes.title: ver 0.8.8.9, date 3/5/2025
notes.content:
[u][b]Items/Attacks[/b][/u]
-Items will have more special effects in the future updates (i.e. poison, drain, burn, slow, etc.)
-NPCs will also have access to these things as well, depending on the NPC

[u][b]Game Balancing[/b][/u]
-EXP chart updated to include more than 15 levels when a player levels up
-More balancing regarding monster level, monster experience, and exp required to level
-Balanced encumbrance bonus/reductions

[u][b]Skill/spells[/b][/u]
-Steal Item improve, and noticeable over higher levels
-Quickness spell difficulty reduced
-Ensnare spell difficulty reduced
-Blur spell cost reduced

[u][b]Other[/b][/u]
-Boss battle music will play if nearby, regardless of threat level to player (i.e. if you're too strong, it'll still be boss music playing)
-If your extra characters are not in your party and not in battle, they will move at “normal appearing” speeds.  Prior to this, extra player characters were running around too fast to click on.
